_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 10-16 September 2025: the Vatican shaking, five angels over America, the draft.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for Europe and for the people of France and Germany over what he has seen coming, naming the swastika, the sacrifice and the witchcraft.
mentions.quote: I pray for the people of France and Germany for what I have seen coming
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over material stated elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He praises God for bringing peace and joy back into homes and families in America and for the biblical blessing.
mentions.quote: bringing peace and joy back into the homes
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says he stands with Israel regardless of what is going on, calls it terrible, and prays for the starving, the children and the dying.
mentions.quote: Yes, people are starving. I pray for the young children
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition that concedes the humanitarian situation.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks for God hand on the nation and says revival is coming from sea to shining sea and across Africa, Asia and South America.
mentions.quote: there is revival coming from sea to shining sea
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over continents.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Rome shaking and the Vatican shaking, and specifies structural damage to the Vatican.
mentions.quote: structural damage on the Vatican
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake causing structural damage to Vatican buildings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Structural damage is a specific and reportable threshold, which is unusual in this material.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will transfer and trickle into Germany, and that he sees Germany bold.
mentions.quote: I SEE GERMANY IS BOLD
mentions.falsify_match: Germany taking an assertive turn.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether there is more and says he is seeing Canada again and the enemy within.
mentions.quote: I see Canada again. The enemy within
mentions.falsify_match: Hostile actors uncovered inside Canada.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The enemy within is restated without new content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he can repeat what he has seen about Canada because he sees it again, and names the earthquakes and British Columbia.
mentions.quote: But the earthquakes again. British Columbia
mentions.falsify_match: A major British Columbia earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was speaking about Alabama and saw Alabama, and that he is more bold when speaking privately than in front of thousands.
mentions.quote: I am more bold whenever I am just talking to us
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an admission that he moderates what he says in larger settings.

mentions.claim_text: He uses corn kernels heating up and starting to pop as the image for what is coming.
mentions.quote: those corn kernels, it is going to start to have a reaction
mentions.falsify_match: A rapid sequence of events after a period of build-up.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The image sets no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a great shaking to awaken and that after what he saw the night before he would like to be able to tell the authorities, naming the Secret Service.
mentions.quote: I would love to be able to tell the authorities
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a wish to report the material, with the content withheld here.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in the spirit from west to east he could hear five angels voices singing woe woe woe America, for a great shaking is coming.
mentions.quote: I could hear five angels voices singing, Whoa, whoa, whoa, America
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: angelic voices in vision with no worldly referent.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord permitted him to say this because it is a natural event, and that he saw a major volcano going off on the west coast.
mentions.quote: on the west coast I saw a major volcano going off
mentions.falsify_match: A major volcanic eruption on the American west coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He distinguishes natural events as things he is allowed to name, which is a rule worth having on file.

mentions.claim_text: He says certain days and weeks can be felt as strong, and that when he got to the 23rd it was so.
mentions.quote: when I got to the 23rd
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event on 23 September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary day. The UNGA high-level week beginning that date was on the published calendar.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over a person he does not name, thanking God for angels aid and assistance.
mentions.quote: I thank you for angels aid and assistance
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over an unnamed person.

mentions.claim_text: He describes fire that is an explosion from the inside out, saying it looks like a 9/11 event with the plane and the way it was smoking.
mentions.quote: it is an explosion from the inside out
mentions.falsify_match: A building explosion originating internally, resembling the 2001 attacks.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Given on 11 September, which is when the comparison would most readily come to mind.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the leaders of Germany, Italy and England, and remarks that England has both a king and a prime minister.
mentions.quote: I see the prime minister of England
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: three leaders seen with nothing attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a group in Damascus that is not a war game, that these people are terrorists, and that everything there is cat and mouse.
mentions.quote: These people in Damascus are terrorists
mentions.falsify_match: A terrorist group operating out of Damascus becoming a public issue.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is a two-sided thing, with the Chinese government side having a plan and an agenda.
mentions.quote: the Chinese government side and what they have a plan
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an assertion that a government has a plan.

mentions.claim_text: He says they wanted to remain neutral as a support giving military supplies, ahead of what is about to kick off at a greater level as the chess match becomes checkmate.
mentions.quote: as the chess match becomes checkmate
mentions.falsify_match: A nominally neutral state supplying materiel before a decisive escalation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The party is not named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He calls every plot and plan of the wicked to be uncovered from sea to shining sea across America.
mentions.quote: Every plot, every plan of the wicked, we call it uncovered
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He calls revival throughout North Korea, Africa, Europe, South America and Brazil.
mentions.quote: We call revival all throughout Africa and Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition over continents.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will not assume, but that he sees red and white and burnt orange and it looks like Texas and like the Longhorns.
mentions.quote: I see the burnt orange and it looks like Texas
mentions.falsify_match: An event connected to Texas or its university colours.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states he will not assume, which is a real hedge.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is just the beginning of what is about to happen and that he saw a named financier behind the scenes.
mentions.quote: This is just the beginning of what is about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: Escalating political violence organised and funded.
mentions.falsify_miss: None established. Given the day of the Kirk killing, and naming a financier is an allegation offered without support.

mentions.claim_text: He says the disarming of the Second Amendment in blue states will be pushed with a wave of anti-gun legislation, and that the Lord said they will see more of it in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: disarming the second amendment in blue states
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of state-level gun legislation following the killing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None at that scale. State legislative activity is a matter of public record.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something influencing Putin toward greater war and then oppressing him, coming over him.
mentions.quote: influencing Vladimir Putin to try to create greater war
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a spirit influencing a named leader has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the French president rise up as an Ishmael to the coming Antichrist, while they are voting and doing what they said they would.
mentions.quote: Macron would rise up similar as an Ishmael to the Antichrist
mentions.falsify_match: The French president taking a forerunner role of the kind described.

mentions.claim_text: He says the thing gets out of control and a draft comes for the American people because there are not enough servicemen and women to fight, with young men and women drafted.
mentions.quote: a draft coming for the American people
mentions.falsify_match: Conscription reinstated in the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The draft ended in 1973 and reinstating it would require an act of Congress, which makes it unmissable.

mentions.claim_text: He describes hearing explosions behind people singing I am dreaming of a white Christmas, as in a Second World War film with the bombs visible.
mentions.quote: as they were singing I am dreaming of a white Christmas
mentions.falsify_match: War escalating around a Christmas period.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The scene is drawn from a film, which he says himself.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls asking about McVeigh and says the Lord gives him key words, telling him it will be in unlikely places and naming Pearl Harbor events.
mentions.quote: it will be in unlikely places. Pearl Harbor events
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack in a place nobody expected.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Unlikely places is the widest possible location, which removes what geography would add.
